subtitle.en: Three Bedroom Apartment with Sea View

description.en:
There are places where the Atlantic doesn't just sit in the background — it fills every window, every morning, every breath. This is one of them. Wake up in either bedroom or drift to the living room, and the sea is right there: vast, unhurried, immediate. Step outside, and the fishing boats are already moving across the water; cross the road, and you can buy the catch directly from the men who brought it in. This is the Algarve before it was discovered — raw, real, and completely alive.

The space
The building has been here long enough to earn its character — worn edges, thick walls, a presence that newer constructions simply cannot manufacture. Two weeks ago, everything inside it was made new. Every surface, every fitting, every detail was stripped back and rebuilt to a premium standard, so what you arrive to is the rare combination of a building with genuine soul and an interior that feels as though no one has lived in it before you.

Both main bedrooms face the sea directly. So does the living room. There is no consolation prize view here, no angled glimpse from a side window — the water is front and centre from the rooms where you will actually spend your time.

Outside the front door, the lota — the traditional fish auction house — sits directly across the road. This is a working fishing village, and that is precisely the point. The sound of boats, the smell of salt air, the rhythm of people who have been doing the same thing in the same place for generations: it becomes the texture of your stay. Walk left or right, and within minutes, you reach restaurants, bars, beach sports, and some of the most unspoiled stretches of coastline the Algarve still has to offer.

THE SPACE

Two bedrooms, both with direct sea views — quality linens, proper storage.

One bedroom with a wide window facing the interior courtyard of the building and the perfect room for the younger ones in the family.

Living room facing the ocean — works as well for a quiet morning coffee as for an evening with the windows open and the sound of the water coming in.

Kitchen fully equipped with new appliances and everything you need to make the most of whatever the fishermen are selling across the road.

Bathroom finished to a clean, contemporary standard with quality amenities provided.

The refurbishment was completed two weeks before listing — the apartment has not been used since. Everything is new.

Managed by Lovely Memories, this property is maintained to the same standards as our wider portfolio: meticulously prepared, professionally managed, and ready for you exactly as shown.

Guest access
Guests have full and private access to the entire apartment. The space is self-contained. Building common areas (entrance, stairwell) are shared with other residents.

Underground parking is unmarked so it´s first come, first served.

Other things to note
The building has age and character. Thick walls, history, a sense that this place has mattered to people for a long time — the kind of charm you cannot replicate in a new-build.

The interior is brand new. Fully refurbished and completed two weeks before listing. You are, in the most literal sense, the first guests to use it.

The fishing village is part of the experience. The lota and working waterfront bring sounds, smells, and an authentic rhythm of local life. Early mornings may carry the activity of boats and fishermen — this is not a flaw, it is the point.

Lovely Memories management. 24/7 support, premium amenities on arrival, and the same standards of care applied across our full portfolio of luxury properties in Porto and the Algarve.

description.en:
Set at the crest of Rua Dom Pedro V, in the storied Massarelos district, Dom Pedro V Residences stands as one of the eight architectural landmarks of Porto. Designed by Adriano Pimenta — whose career was shaped by fifteen years alongside Eduardo Souto de Moura and the coordination of Metro do Porto — and featured in ArchDaily and Archello, this is a project that belongs to the city's architectural canon as much as it belongs to those who call it home.

The development unfolds across 2,900 sqm of ancient granite walls that follow three surrounding streets and trace the contours of Porto's urban topography. At its heart, a centuries-old granite manor has been sensitively restored and reimagined as Casa Dom Pedro, a boutique guesthouse offering seven suites across two floors, complete with a pool and shared outdoor spaces. Around it, three new concrete structures — Casa Jardim, Casa Terraço, and Casa Boavista — introduce 25 homes ranging from one to three bedrooms, each with private access to patios, balconies, or secluded gardens. Granite terraces and retaining walls were redesigned, merging old stone with new concrete and vegetation suspended from beams, creating a landscape that feels both rooted and elevated.

The east-facing orientation preserves privacy and calm, while privileged views over the Douro River reward those who look up from the terraces of Dom Pedro V.

The interiors carry the personal signature of João Santos, founder of Lovely Memories — a mark of authorship that transforms each residence into a curated experience rather than simply a furnished space.

Qualquer toalha extra além do conjunto que disponibilizamos tem um custo de 20 euros por peça.

The space
